Goal: Increase lint pass rate of the autoresearch-composer skill codebase by iteratively proposing and evaluating lint-rule-compliant candidates until the pass rate reaches 100 % or the iteration budget is exhausted.
Scope: All source files covered by the project's configured linter (e.g., ESLint, Ruff, or shellcheck) under skills/autoresearch-composer/ and its referenced modules.
Metric: lint_pass_rate — proportion of lint checks that exit with status 0 out of total checks run, expressed as a float in [0.0, 1.0].

Verify.procedure: Run the project linter in non-fix mode and parse its exit codes and error-count output. Compute lint_pass_rate = (total_checks - failing_checks) / total_checks. The verifier must return a JSON object with keys: baseline_rate (float), candidate_rate (float), delta (float), checks_total (int), checks_failed (int).
Verify.baseline_binding: Freeze the lint_pass_rate measured on HEAD before generating any candidate. Store as baseline_rate in each iteration's result record.
Verify.matched_identity: Baseline and candidate runs must use the same linter binary, version, configuration file, and file set. Only the source under treatment differs.

Guard.name: invariant_guard
invariants: candidate_rate >= baseline_rate  — no regression allowed; if candidate_rate < baseline_rate the candidate is REJECTED and the arm is preserved as FAIL.
lint_pass_rate never decreases across adopted iterations  — each ADOPT must record a strictly non-decreasing sequence of accepted rates.
No new lint rules may be suppressed or disabled to inflate pass rate  — any suppression directive introduced by the candidate triggers BLOCK + Human-Admit-Required.
Hard-gate: if lint_pass_rate == 1.0 after candidate application, stop immediately with HANDOFF(terminal=PASS).
Hard-gate: if three consecutive candidates produce delta == 0 (no-uplift) the loop stops with HANDOFF(terminal=STALLED).

per_iteration.generate: Produce the smallest diff expected to fix the highest-density lint cluster (fewest files, most errors eliminated).
per_iteration.run: Apply candidate diff to a matched subject branch, re-run verifier, record result.
per_iteration.decide: ADOPT if candidate_rate > baseline_rate and all invariants pass; REJECT otherwise; BLOCK if any suppression directive detected; ITERATE if budget remaining and expected gain positive.
per_iteration.lineage: Each iteration record must include: iteration_id (int), baseline_rate (float), candidate_rate (float), delta (float), decision (ADOPT|REJECT|BLOCK|ITERATE), reason (str), remaining_budget (int).
